name: Protector of Darkshire raises Dawn Blade and Dusk Blade damage 15 percent (#1657)
contract: Protector of Darkshire 300575 is SpellFamily 21, passive (Attributes 0x1c0), with one SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) effect: MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), BasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = +15 percent, EffectSpellClassMask word 0 = 0x600, i.e. bit 0x400 (Dawn Blade 802024, 802248) and bit 0x200 (Dusk Blade 802020, 802253, off-hand 803502). Both blades' SpellFamilyFlags word 0 carry those bits and neither has SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS. Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone applies ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) (Unit.cpp:9369) and Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone does the same for weapon strikes (Unit.cpp:10914); SPELLMOD_DAMAGE is multiplicative for pct mods (Player.cpp:10272), so 1000 becomes 1150 and the damage-path ratio is 1.15. The scenario pins the raw modifier and the two native damage calculations, with Shadow Trap (not in the mask) as the control.
